text:
nina: Quick update from Mirador call — theyre offering a 3-week preview of the T3200 EdgeBoard. NDA signed, embargo for 7 days after partner sign-off. They want a lean "onramp lite": marketplace container + one-run perf snapshot + feedback form. Can we sketch owners and immediate risks?

omar: I'm +owner for infra. Immediate asks: lab access (timeboxed), power telemetry endpoint, and artifact format for marketplace container. Mirador prefers OCI image with a small startup shim.

ben: I can handle the bench harness. Recommend minimal suite: smoke, seq128 latency sweep, and a short convo script (30 turns). Models: redwood/llm-1.3b and redwood/llm-3b. Will aim for reproducible runs and attach run_id.

jen: Legal: embargo + 7 days is ok but note export control clause in the NDA. Also, Mirador disallows publishing raw power numbers publicly without explicit sign-off. We'll need partner approval flow for any figures.

legal-bot: Action required: legal redline checklist will be posted by EOD. Do not publish numbers until approval.

nina: Security note: Mirador agent can be toggled; default telemetry off. If enabled, must strip PII client-side. Use salted hashes for MACs and IPs.

omar: For power telemetry Mirador exposes JSON at `http://10.10.50.2:8080/telemetry` with a token header. I'll request short-lived tokens and rotate per-session.

ben: Example run I'll use:```
./bench --model redwood/llm-1.3b --seq 512 --batch 1 --mode perf --power-endpoint http://10.10.50.2:8080/power --out ./artifacts/run123.csv
metrics: tokens/s, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, avg_watts
```

jen: Marketing wants a one-pager template and logo assets. Marketing lead will need 5 business days after sign-off to prepare a co-branded page.

nina: Ops: can we produce both an OCI container and a marketplace manifest? Mirador prefers container first; marketplace will host the manifest + checksums.

omar: Yes. Container will be built from `edge-base:2026-04` image, kernel 5.15, driver 535.x. I'll pin those in the manifest and produce a sha256 for the artifact.

ben: I'll run both `release/mirador-1` and `main` branches as Mirador requested and include branch in the telemetry metadata. Will run each job x2 for quick median.

deploy-bot: build: container-edge-mirador:2026-04-07-01 succeeded (artifact sha256: abc123...)

jen: Legal reminder: create an approval slot for Mirador to review run artifacts within 48 hours of posting. We'll block any public release until their sign-off.

nina: Risk register (top 3): 1) lab time shortage blocking runs, 2) telemetry containing unexpected PII, 3) driver mismatch causing perf delta. Bring mitigations to tomorrow sync.

omar: Mitigation notes: reserve 8h/day lab blocks for week 1, scrub telemetry client-side, and test driver compatibility on a small soak node before the main runs.

ben: I'll upload baseline CSVs to /s/mirador/pilot/runs and tag objects with `pilot=mirador` and `branch=`. I'll scrub MACs before upload.

jen: I'll circulate the NDA redline checklist and embargo calendar. Marketing: @ella please prepare the one-pager template; we won't publish until partner ok.

nina: Meeting tomorrow 09:00 PT to finalize owners and schedule. Please bring a 2-line owner assignment and any blocking issues.

ben: I'll have the harness checklist and a short sample result table.

omar: I'll bring the container manifest and token rotation plan.

nina: Thanks all :thumbsup: post-sync we'll update this thread with run times and first artifacts.
